reacquired_failure_reason.reason: WorkerSessionRegistry::renewHeldSession writes failure_reason => null and closed_at => null through array_filter(... !== null), which drops both; a reacquired session stays active with the old failure_reason until a heartbeat or close clears it. Native clears it, as the code intends.

contract: Worker sessions over the worker protocol and their visibility on the control plane, as published Server 2.11.1 serves them: the protocol gates (no header 400, below 1.8 409 worker_sessions_unavailable, above 1.20 400), validation, registration (412) and queue (409) refusals, requirements checked before the session lookup, create (201), reuse and reacquire (200, options the request omits reset to defaults, the TTL deadline never extended, the queue defaulting to the worker's own), heartbeat (lease renewed from now, stored lease unchanged), the per-worker session limit, lease and TTL expiry applied when the session is read, close and already_closed, the reacquire refusals, a deregistered holder orphaned on read, and the namespace list and metrics. Session times are whole seconds, so times are compared as spans. One published defect is bounded: a reacquired session keeps its old failure_reason (renewHeldSession filters out its own null clears); the published value or the intended null is accepted. Embedded applications have no worker protocol.
